app.name: Instagram
app.description: A free photo and video sharing app from Meta with feeds, Stories, Reels, and direct messaging, used by over 2 billion people worldwide.

verdict.one_liner: Collects extensive activity data and shares it across Meta Companies for advertising.
verdict.summary: The privacy policy states that Instagram collects detailed activity, device, and content information to personalize ads. This data is shared with other Meta Companies and used to show ads on third-party apps and websites through Meta Audience Network. Users can delete their account, and the policy explicitly states Meta does not sell information.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The policy states that your activity on Instagram is used to personalize ads and may be shared across Meta Companies and with third-party advertisers. If you prefer to limit behavioral tracking, consider whether this trade-off is acceptable.

red.title: Your activity is used to personalize ads on and off Meta Products
red.plain_english: The policy states that your activity, content interactions, and time spent are used to personalize ads, and that information from third parties about activity off Meta Products is used to tailor ads on websites, apps, and devices.

red.title: Your information is shared across Meta Companies
red.plain_english: The policy states that your information is shared with other Meta Companies to help provide, improve, and promote Meta Company Products, including for ads and product experiences across those platforms.

red.title: Device identifiers used to show ads on other apps
red.plain_english: The policy states that when ads are shown through Meta Audience Network on other apps, your collected information is used to identify you as a Meta Product user and tailor the ads you see.

red.title: App foreground status and device signals are monitored
red.plain_english: The policy states it collects information about what you are doing on your device, such as whether the app is in the foreground or if your mouse is moving, to help tell humans from bots.

green.title: You can delete your information or account
green.plain_english: The policy states you can delete your information or account.

green.title: The policy explicitly states it does not sell your information
green.plain_english: The policy explicitly states: We don't sell any of your information to anyone, and we never will.

green.title: You are notified before material policy changes
green.plain_english: The policy states you will be notified before material changes and given the opportunity to review the revised policy before continuing to use the Products.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The policy states that camera and voice features are used when you choose to create content or use voice-enabled features.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone access are user-initiated for creating content, voice and video calls, and voice-enabled features. The policy does not mention background access.
categories.policy_excerpt: Content you provide through our camera feature or your camera roll settings, or through our voice-enabled features

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The policy states it collects location-related information, including GPS location shared through your device settings.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting location-related information and GPS location from device settings. It states this is used to personalize features, content, recommendations, and ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information you've shared through your device settings (like GPS location)
concerns: GPS location collected from device settings
Location used for personalization and ads

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The policy does not explicitly state that Instagram accesses your device's phonebook or contacts.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting information about friends, followers, and other connections within Meta Products, but does not explicitly mention uploading or accessing your device's contact list.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The policy states you may choose to provide content through your camera roll settings.
categories.detail: The policy mentions camera roll settings, implying photos and videos may be accessed when you choose to share content. This is user-initiated.
categories.policy_excerpt: Content you provide through our camera feature or your camera roll settings

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: The policy states your information is shared with other Meta Companies and may be used to show ads on other apps through Meta Audience Network.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that information is shared with other Meta Companies for ads and product experiences across platforms. It also states that information from third parties is used to tailor ads on Meta Products and on other websites, apps, and devices.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share information with other Meta Companies to help provide, improve, and promote Meta Company Products, including for ads and products experience across those platforms.
concerns: Data shared across Meta Companies for advertising
Ads shown on other apps via Meta Audience Network
Third-party activity data used for ad targeting

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The policy states you must provide information to create an account, including your name, username, and profile picture.
categories.detail: Account creation requires providing personal information. Public profile information includes name, username, and profile picture. The policy mentions linking accounts across Meta Products.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your public profile information (including your name, username and profile picture)
concerns: Real identity required
Profile data public by default
Account may be linkable to other Meta products

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The policy states your activity, content interactions, and time spent are used to personalize ads, and information from third parties is used to tailor ads on and off Meta Products.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly describes collecting types of content viewed, interactions, time, frequency, and duration of activities. It states that information from advertisers and partners about activity off Meta Products is used to tailor ads, and that Meta Audience Network shows ads on other apps using collected information.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use information we collect to provide a personalized experience to you, including ads
concerns: Activity data used for ad personalization
Third-party activity data used for ad targeting
Ads shown on other apps via Meta Audience Network

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The provided policy text does not explicitly address children's data handling or age requirements for Instagram.
categories.detail: The privacy policy excerpt reviewed does not contain explicit language about age requirements or children's data protections for Instagram.
concerns: Policy is silent on age requirements in the provided text

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The policy states it collects information about the network you connect to, including your IP address.
categories.detail: IP address and network information are collected. The policy does not explicitly state that IP address is used for location inference, but it is collected as part of device and network information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information about the network you connect your device to, including your IP address
concerns: Connection metadata logged continuously
IP address collected automatically

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The policy states it collects device characteristics, unique identifiers, and signals that tell your device apart from other users' devices.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly lists device characteristics, device software, unique identifiers, device signals, and information about whether the app is in the foreground. It also mentions cookies and similar technologies.
categories.policy_excerpt: Identifiers that tell your device apart from other users'
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
App foreground status monitored
Device signals used for identification

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The policy does not mention health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data is referenced in the provided privacy policy text.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The policy states that purchase and transaction information, including truncated credit card information, is collected.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collecting purchases and other transactions, including truncated credit card information. It does not explicitly state that full payment details are stored.
categories.policy_excerpt: Purchases or other transactions you make, including truncated credit card information
concerns: Purchase history collected
Truncated credit card information retained

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: The policy states you can delete your account, but some information may be kept to provide Products or comply with legal obligations.
categories.detail: Account deletion is available. However, the policy states information may be retained as long as needed to provide Products, comply with legal obligations, or protect interests. The duration is decided case-by-case.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can delete your information or account
concerns: Retention period not clearly defined
Some data kept for legal and safety purposes

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The policy states you will be notified before material changes and given the opportunity to review the revised policy.
categories.detail: The policy states users will be notified before material changes and will have the opportunity to review the revised policy before choosing to continue using the Products.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will notify you before we make material changes to this Policy.
